beschreibung:
The Queen of the Pustertal in Osttirol

Majestically situated on a steep rocky ridge at the entrance to the Villgratental, Burg Heinfels is regarded as one of the most impressive fortifications in Tirol. The extensive fortress, often hailed as the Queen of the Pustertal, once served as a strategic stronghold of the Grafen von Görz.

Vibrant Fortress History and Museum Tour

Following meticulous revitalization, the historic monument presents itself as a multi-faceted museum. Visitors explore the Laurentiuskapelle, fortified bastions, and the magnificent Knights' Hall on marked tour paths, while multimedia exhibits illustrate its eventful history.
